title: What's new in Finance: Overview
summary: This video gives an overview of the finance changes in the 2026 wave 2 release. It covers improvements to excise taxes and self-billing that were first delivered in an earlier wave, and a short look at cross environment master data management. It then covers withholding tax for employees, which also works outside the expense agent, and a round-up of localization updates for Spain, France, Australia, Great Britain, Germany, Switzerland, Austria and Iceland. Several excise and localization items are marked as coming in November or December rather than in the initial release.

features.name: Multiple excise taxes per item
features.description: The excise fast tab on the item card is replaced by a new Excise Taxes page, opened from Related on the item. You can add as many excise taxes to one item as needed, for example for items with both plastic and sugar.
caveats: Only one excise per item was possible in the previous version

features.name: Automatic upgrade of excise configuration
features.description: If excise taxes were already in use from the previous wave, the system automatically upgrades the existing configuration to the new table and page. No manual action is needed.
prerequisites: Excise taxes already set up in the previous wave

features.name: Bonded location for excise
features.description: A location can be marked so that excise duty is not calculated on inbound receipt of stock. The system calculates excise duty only when goods are released from the bonded location.
features.status_evidence_quote: This is something what is coming in November minor, two new features.
caveats: Delivered in the November minor update, not in the initial release

features.name: Transfer entry type in excise permission
features.description: Excise permission now supports the transfer entry type, in addition to the sales, purchase and manufacturing types that existed before.
features.status_evidence_quote: This is something what is coming in November minor, two new features.
caveats: Presented together with the bonded location feature coming in November

features.name: Ad valorem and hybrid excise calculation models
features.description: New calculation models for excise: ad valorem calculates excise as a percent of a taxable amount, and hybrid combines a specific component (for example by weight) with an ad valorem component.
features.status_evidence_quote: So, this is what is coming in November.
caveats: Needed only in rare situations, the specific model covers about 90% of cases

features.name: Self-billing number series per vendor
features.description: If you have multiple self-billing vendors, you can select a specific number series for each of them. Without a specific series, the system uses the number series from Payables setup.
caveats: Optional: you can keep the existing single number series for all vendors

features.name: Self-billing PEPPOL format
features.description: A PEPPOL format is added for self-billing, so self-billing becomes part of the invoicing or e-documents framework.

features.name: Cross environment master data management
features.description: Master data management setup is extended so it works across environments, with the same approach and user experience as master data management within one environment. It helps in particular when multiple localizations require multiple environments. Details are in a separate session.
caveats: Only an overview here, the deep dive is in a separate session
prerequisites: Multiple environments, for example one per localization

features.name: Withholding tax for employees
features.description: Existing withholding taxes are extended with a business posting group option to choose between vendors and employees. Employees get gross or net calculation, simple calculation, and different thresholds per period and category. It can be used in the general journal and is not limited to the expense agent.
caveats: More withholding tax functionality is planned as a next step
prerequisites: Business posting group set to employees

features.name: Verifactu enablement in Spain
features.description: Verifactu (as heard, 'very fact two') enablement in Spain is generally available. It needs setup, documented on Microsoft Learn, and the feature is also on AppSource if it was uninstalled by accident.
features.status_evidence_quote: very fact two enablement in Spain is now in GA
caveats: It will be mandatory from the beginning of next year

features.name: Invoicing for France
features.description: Invoicing for France is introduced in this wave.
features.status_evidence_quote: Now, we introduce invoicing for France. It will be in GA as well.

features.name: Payment times for Australia and Great Britain
features.description: Payment times rules are expanded for Australia and Great Britain.
features.status_evidence_quote: So, this is what is already inside.

features.name: Intrastat reporting for Germany and QR invoicing address for Switzerland
features.description: New Intrastat reporting in Germany based on new Intrastat core rules, and fully structured address support for QR invoicing in Switzerland.
features.status_evidence_quote: So, this is what is already inside.

features.name: EU BP file export for Germany
features.description: EU BP files (name as heard) can be exported with the audit file export, for the German localization only.
features.status_evidence_quote: But in November, December, we will deliver two more features
caveats: Name may be mangled by the captions

features.name: SFT in Austria and Iceland
features.description: SFT (as heard) is enabled for Austria and Iceland localizations. It is standard functionality that already exists and is only being applied to these two localizations.
features.status_evidence_quote: we will enable SFT in Austria and Iceland starting from December
caveats: Name may be mangled by the captions
